about_the_game:
You are a former government operative — weaponized and altered by clandestine experiments — now haunted by the brutal murder of your parents.
In a dystopian city of the 1990s, vengeance is your only purpose.

Take on assassination contracts from a shadowy syndicate, infiltrate gang hideouts, dismantle corporate militias, and carve through rival factions. Each mission pushes you deeper into the rotten core of the city, trading blood for answers as you hunt those responsible for your family’s massacre.

Gameplay Features:

  • Fast-paced combat: Face waves of enemies armed with guns while you rely on your katana, quick reflexes, and brutal finishing strikes.

  • Augmented abilities: Use experimental powers — heightened speed, enhanced strength, and supernatural reflexes — to dodge bullets, close distance, and turn the battlefield in your favor.

  • Tactical encounters: Every level is a deadly puzzle of positioning, timing, and precision where a single mistake can cost your life.

  • Progression & upgrades: Unlock new powers and refine your playstyle as you adapt to increasingly dangerous missions.

  • Stylized world: A retro 90s-inspired city soaked in neon, blood, and betrayal, brought to life with pixel art and a pulsing synth soundtrack.

Survival demands precision, speed, and adaptability. Each strike matters, every choice has weight, and the line between justice and obsession grows thinner with every kill.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description
This game contains explicit violence, including:

Blood and gore during combat.

Corpses and partially mutilated bodies (e.g., characters cut in half).

Use of melee weapons (swords, knives) and firearms.

The game features graphic depictions of violence that may not be suitable for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU compatible OpenGL 3.3 (Intel HD Graphics 4000 ou équivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 450 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 (3.0 GHz) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 / Intel UHD 620 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 450 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
